name: Laptop node
summary: A laptop or desktop joins the agent as a node so the agent can see the screen, read and move files and run local apps or commands on it. It is how a cloud- or server-hosted agent reaches the machine you actually work on.
facts: OpenClaw macOS, Windows and Linux apps; headless node host
Screen capture, computer use, system.run, file transfer
Full access to your real environment, with matching blast radius
goodFor: Acting in desktop apps with no API
Working on local files and repos
Reaching a personal machine from a hosted agent
watchOut: Command execution on your main machine is risky
Only works while the laptop is awake and online
how: Run the agent's desktop app or headless node host on the laptop
Grant screen recording, accessibility and file permissions
The agent invokes screen, file, exec or computer-use commands on that machine
